title: Desk area cleaned
description: Deep-clean a home-office desk: floor around the desk clear, surfaces wiped, monitor and keyboard dust-free, rubbish removed.

criteria.label: Floor around the desk is clear of dust and marks
Desk surface is wiped, no dust or sticky marks
No wrappers or rubbish visible near the desk

notes: Full clean of a small public desk area; write the 4-digit code on a sticky note in the AFTER frame. Before shot and after shot from the same standing position.
